moderation.sessionRequiredBody: This screen expects an access token from the session layer. Public or server credentials are never stored here.

moderation.notePlaceholder: Describe why it should be removed...
moderation.hideBody: The report will stop being shown publicly, but it stays in the queue and can be restored. Record the reason for the audit trail.
moderation.hideNotePlaceholder: Describe why it should be hidden...
moderation.restoreBody: The report goes back to pending review; it will not be public until someone approves it. Record the reason for the audit trail.

configuration.title: Review thresholds
configuration.subtitle: Adjust the criteria used to review and protect reports.

fields.flag_auto_hide_threshold: Flags required to hide a report

help.flag_auto_hide_threshold: Flags from distinct origins that trigger review.
help.duplicate_radius_meters: Maximum distance for suggesting a potential duplicate.
help.duplicate_time_window_minutes: Maximum time between possible duplicate reports.
help.trust_medium_threshold: Must be lower than the high trust threshold.
help.gps_accuracy_max_meters: Less accurate positions require report review.
help.report_rate_limit_per_hour: Maximum new reports per origin in one hour.
help.flag_rate_limit_per_hour: Maximum flags per origin in one hour.

configuration.reasonHelp: Required. Explain why you are publishing this configuration.
configuration.reasonPlaceholder: For example: adjust the distance after reviewing nearby reports.
configuration.saveExplanation: Saving publishes a new version. The previous configuration remains in history.
configuration.fixFields: Check the highlighted fields before saving.
configuration.sessionBody: You need a current Administrator session to view and change these values.
configuration.forbiddenBody: Only an active Administrator account can manage thresholds.
configuration.verifyBeforeRetry: Publication could not be confirmed. Check the active version before saving again to avoid creating an extra version by mistake.
configuration.discardBody: Your edits to this form will be lost. The published configuration will not change.

validation.integer: Must be a whole number without decimal places.
validation.precision: Use no more than {{decimals}} decimal places.
validation.trustOrder: Must be lower than the high trust threshold.
validation.note: Enter a nonblank reason with 1–1000 characters.

errors.request_failed: The request could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.configuration_unavailable: No active configuration is available. Ask the technical team to check the environment.
errors.preflight_mismatch: The server environment requires technical review.
errors.invalid_response: The server did not return a valid configuration. Reload the values.
errors.invalid_request: Check the values and the reason for the change.
errors.configuration_conflict: Configuration changed during publication. Check the active version.
